collection.description: The communal children's house is short of helpers.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: The communal children's house is short of helpers. (Name1) volunteers for the afternoon, expecting to carry water and tidy mats. Instead, he finds himself surrounded by children who all seem to need something at once.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The children invent their own rules, and the afternoon passes joyfully.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: An argument breaks out, and he helps the children negotiate without deciding everything for them.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: One child prefers the old, crooked toy and asks him not to change it.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The children begin greeting him by name, and he becomes a dependable presence.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: He discovers the work is tiring and arranges a sustainable schedule rather than making promises he cannot keep.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: He patiently settles a fussy toddler and earns a sleepy smile.
